definitions.gloss: to permit; to allow; to authorize; to grant permission
definitions.explanation: To officially grant permission for an action or activity. Implies that the person giving permission holds authority to allow or deny, and is used in institutional, legal, and workplace contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{許可|きょか}する。
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I take time off after getting permission from my supervisor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You cannot do business in this location without a business permit.

notes:
To officially grant permission for something. Implies authority — the person giving ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ has the power to allow or deny. Commonly used in institutional, legal, and workplace contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [action]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{許可|きょか}する: to permit [action]
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give permission to [person]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue permission
- ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to obtain permission
- ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to request permission
- ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without permission
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: business license/permit
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: building permit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to allow/recognize — less formal; can mean to acknowledge or approve in a broader sense
- ⟦{了承|りょうしょう}する→了承する：20062_ryoushousuru⟧: to consent/accept — accepting a situation rather than granting official permission
- ⟦{承認|しょうにん}する→承認する：20064_shouninsuru⟧: to approve — formal approval, often of proposals or documents
- ⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to forgive/permit — more personal and emotional; can mean both forgiving and allowing
